## What changed

Describe the focused change and the user-visible or analytical consequence.

## Evidence

- [ ] Theoretical claims use complete source identities and verified locations.
- [ ] The strongest plausible counter-analysis was considered where relevant.
- [ ] No copyrighted source files, extracted source text, private indexes, or absolute local paths are included.

## Validation

- [ ] Plugin validation passes.
- [ ] Skill validation passes.
- [ ] `git diff --check` passes.
- [ ] README links and examples were checked if documentation changed.
